name: buried-behavioural-hunk
description: A cleanup of the webhook dispatcher: imports sorted, retry literals extracted into constants, the cl field renamed to client, sendOnce renamed to post, err renamed to lastErr, a log message and an error message reworded, the timer variable spelled out. All mechanical, except that the retry loop's `if !retryable(err)` lost its negation in the rename to lastErr. The seeded line sits in the busiest hunk, between renames that touch the lines either side of it.

expected.why: Transient failures such as a 503 are now returned on the first attempt without any retry, while permanently rejected deliveries are retried five times with backoff.
